title: The Helpful Pup
lines: Our pup Bud has no teeth at all.
Bud is toothless, but he is helpful.
Meg lost a sock and felt hopeless.
She looked in the box. No sock.
Bud went to sniff at the rug.
He dug up the sock and set it in her hand.
Meg was thankful for her toothless pup.

questions.listenFor: A sock. Simple to find - have them put a finger on the line that says it.

questions.ask: How did Bud get the sock back to Meg?
questions.listenFor: He dug it up and set it in her hand. Listen for both halves of that.

questions.ask: Do you think a toothless pup can still be a good pet? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. You are listening for a because, not for the right opinion.
